text: dsh-compact-selected-model 是面向 DSH Web 会话压缩的插件：它在全局 llm/stream 流程中拦截 compaction 请求，并读取会话中尚未消费的模型选择，将摘要请求改送到当前选中的 provider 和 model。它保留请求中的消息、工具、令牌上限与信号，也尊重显式指定的摘要模型；普通请求不会改动。适合切换模型后希望 /compact 或压力触发的自动压缩使用新模型的用户。需要 session controller 提供 modelSelection 投影；没有该投影时保持原路由。

dsh-compact-selected-model routes compaction summaries to the session's pending model choice. It intercepts compaction requests and preserves explicit summary routes and ordinary requests. It requires the session controller's modelSelection projection.
切换模型后，怎么让 /compact 用我刚选的模型？
让 DSH 的会话摘要跟随当前模型选择。
自动压缩总是跑在上一个模型上，有办法改成当前模型吗？
我想保留切换模型的选择，让后续压缩摘要也使用它。
Can session compaction use the model I just selected?
Route automatic compaction summaries to my current model choice.
dsh-compact-selected-model 的功能「跟随当前模型压缩」：存在待处理模型选择时，压缩摘要改用所选模型；普通请求参数保持不变。
dsh-compact-selected-model 的功能「尊重显式摘要模型」：如果压缩请求目标与会话最近路由模型不同，插件将其视为显式配置并保持原样，避免覆盖用户指定的 summarization 模型。
dsh-compact-selected-model 的功能「隔离非压缩请求」：只有 purpose 为 compaction 的请求才会检查会话模型选择；普通 LLM 请求和插件自己重新发出的请求会继续原有流程。
dsh-compact-selected-model 使用前须知：若所选模型请求失败，压缩也会失败，插件不会回退到旧模型；需切回可用模型后重试（见 lib/index.js:15-19）。
dsh-compact-selected-model 使用前须知：功能依赖 session controller 的 modelSelection 投影；无此投影的无头运行不会重路由压缩请求（见 lib/index.js:49-52）。
切换到新模型后，自动整理上下文也想用它。
Make compaction follow the model selected in my session.

dsh-compact-selected-model README · dsh-compact-selected-model：By default, DeepSeek Harness compacts a session with the model that answered the
last turn. If you switch models in the picker and then run `/compact`, the old
model still writes the summary. With this plugin, the summary is written by the
model you have selected now.

Works with dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 through 0.2.x.

dsh-compact-selected-model README · Install：```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-compact-selected-model
```

Then restart `dsh web`.

dsh-compact-selected-model README · How it works：Picking a model in the web UI adds a `model/selection` event to the session.
That choice stays pending until the next request uses it. The plugin hooks
`llm/stream`. When a request has `purpose: 'compaction'` and the session has a
pending model, the plugin sends the request to that model. Nothing else in the
request changes.

The plugin leaves the request alone if `compaction-basic` has an explicit
`summarizationModel` set. Other requests are never touched.

dsh-compact-selected-model README · How it works：If the selected model fails, for example because of a rate limit or a context
window that is too small, the compaction fails too. Switch back to a working
model and run `/compact` again.

dsh-compact-selected-model README · Caveats：- The `compaction/summary` event in the session log still names the old model,
  because compaction-basic writes that record itself. The host log shows where
  the request actually went.
- The auto-compaction threshold is still based on the context window of the
  previous model.
- This needs the `modelSelection` projection from the session controller, so it
  does nothing in headless runs.
dsh-compact-selected-model README · Development：`node smoke.mjs` runs an offline check against a stub LLM service.
